_purpose: EXPLORATORY, not a gate run. First look at lambda = 0 (global term only, no cap), the case published as first order with the graph breaking into baby universes ([T25] Cycle condensation; [KTB19] Sec. 3.3.1 and Fig. 5). Questions: where is the transition, do cooling and heating disagree (hysteresis), and does the cold phase shatter (columns pieces, largest_frac, baby_frac, cube_frac; ASSUMPTIONS Q8). Sizes are multiples of 16 so that a perfect tiling by 4-cubes exists. The heating leg continues from the cold end of the cooling leg. Coupling grid and run lengths chosen by eye from a short probe; nothing here is pre-registered.
name: cqg_lam0_first_look
